scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/finalize.mjs chrome
scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit && vite build --mode firefox && node scripts/finalize.mjs firefox
scripts.zip: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && node scripts/zip.mjs chrome
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && node scripts/zip.mjs firefox && node scripts/source-zip.mjs
